family_reports.body: Judge Keven O’Grady forced me to pay for supervised visits for a mother that attempted suicide in front of a 5 year old. “As many visits as she wants” at $100/hour.

This system removed my children without due process, ignored evidence that cleared me, and created financial and procedural barriers that have kept me separated from them for years. The court actors built a system where I have to pay thousands just to try to be their mom again.
The court system has taken Away my son's mother my other kids brother Kevin o Grady needs to be exposed he claims he does things for the kids safety no he breaks families

public_comments.comment_text: Ordered removal of my five children without a full hearing, without any witnesses or ever asking me if the allegations were true, and still has not given me a real hearing while I have been separated from my kids for over two years, and requires me to find and pay for supervisors with unrealistic requirements like providing their full case history before he will even set a hearing, which has made it nearly impossible to see my children.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent
